description: The merchandise under consideration is referred to as Saturnia stone. This analysis has been completed. Saturnia is a charcoal gray to black stone mottled with patches of brown and white flecks. From the information you provided, it will measure between 115 to 122 inches in length, between 65 to 75 inches in width, and either 0.75 inches or 1.5 inches in thickness. After importation, it will be cut to size and shape for such applications as kitchen countertops, bathroom surfaces, and surfaces for office furniture. The top of the stone has been polished and the sides are simply cut or sawn.

The merchandise under consideration is a fine metallic powder, identified as HMP-SAC-38-25A Solder Powder. The stated components are tin (CAS no. 7440-31-5), silver Ag powder (CAS no. 7740-22-4), and copper metal (CAS no. 7440-50-8).

The imported item is an unfinished facial exfoliating cloth composed of two layers of 100 percent cotton cheesecloth fabric. The two layers of fabric are treated with tannin pre-mordant, cut into 6 x 6-inch squares, and sewn together with an overlock stitch. After importation, a charcoal dye is applied, and a decorative zigzag border stitch is sewn around the edges. The finished product is sold as a facial exfoliating cloth under the Romjay™ brand. The “So Polished Facial Cloth Refill,” SKU R-LE002, is sold at retail with two cloths. The “So Polished Facial Cloth Kit,” SKU K-LE001, is sold at retail with two cloths and a magnetic hanger.

Pantoprazole Sodium, imported in 20 mg, and 40 mg delayed-release tablets, belongs to a class of medications called proton pump inhibitors (PPIs). It is indicated for the treatment of erosive esophagitis, gastric acid hypersecretion, and to promote healing of tissue damage caused by gastric acid.

Style LD-4330 is a men’s jacket constructed from both knit and woven components. The hood, sleeves, back yoke, and the shoulders, are constructed from 100% polyamide woven fabric. The balance of the garment is constructed from 82% polyester, and 18% elastane knit fabric. The hood and sleeves are removable and attached at the shoulders by means of zipper closures. The garment features a hood, full frontal opening secured with zipper closures, round neckline, long sleeves with thumb holes and an elasticized binding tape at the cuffs, pockets below the waist secured by zipper closures, and the garment bottom is bound with an elasticized binding tape. Neither the knit fabric nor the woven fabric exceeds 60% of the garment’s visible surface area. Moreover, neither fabric imparts the essential character of the garment.

The kit is comprised of five acrylic paint pods in assorted colors, two paint brushes, one clear acrylic sheet, one sheet of paper with a printed image, and one small wooden stand. All of the kit’s components are intended to be used together to creatively paint and display the acrylic sheet.

The merchandise under consideration is identified as the Solid Plenum Cat6 cable with is described as a gigabit ethernet data cable which is commonly used for structured cabling projects such as vertical, horizontal, or backbone systems. The cable is internally constructed of 23 AWG copper wire insulated with FEP. Two color matched conductors are twisted together to form a pair, and four pairs are assembled to form a core. The core is jacked with a low smoke flame retardant PVC. The cables are imported on reels to be cut to the desired length by the end user and are not terminated with any connectors. The rated voltage of the cables is stated to be 48 volts. In use, the cables transmit data and other information within various installation scenarios.

Product information was submitted with your request. The items under consideration are five models of floating hull protectors. They are described as floating structures designed to reduce marine growth on submerged hull surfaces by limiting water contact and movement. During use, the hull protectors are positioned on the water’s surface and secured to a marina berth with mooring lines. A vessel is then guided onto the floating protector’s upper surface where it will remain stationary. Once the vessel is positioned, standing water is routed away from the hull while outer bumpers stop additional water from entering the area. Based on the submitted information, the floating hull protectors primarily consist of reinforced, marine-grade polyvinyl chloride (PVC) materials, buoyant closed-cell foam, and laminated low-density polyethylene (LDPE) bubble material. The floating hull protectors will be imported fully assembled and ready to use in five sizes: extra small, small, medium, large, and extra large. Despite different sizes, you clarify that all models are identical in construction, materials, and principal use. You assert that the floating hull protectors will neither be attached to nor form a part of a vessel. Additionally, they will not function as a dock, pier, or fixed marine structure.

The subject merchandise consists of hexane-1,3,6-tricarbonotrile (CAS No. 1772-25-4), in liquid form, with a purity of 99.5 percent or greater. The product is primarily used as an additive in lithium-ion battery electrolytes.

You have submitted photographs and a detailed description of an item identified as a paper chain garland, item number 45534701, which consists of 48 strips of paper in eight bright colors, each measuring approximately 11.02” by 1.57”. Famotidine Oral Suspension, imported in 40 mg/5 mL, is a histamine H2 receptor antagonist. It is indicated for the treatment of active duodenal ulcer (DU), active gastric ulcer (GU), symptomatic nonerosive gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), erosive esophagitis due to GERD, and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.

Product information and photos were submitted for our review. The product under consideration is Item 865858, a decorative owl figure. The form of the figure is constructed of Styrofoam, and the form is covered with multiple materials. The eyes (the most prominent feature) of the owl are surrounded by natural, unspun sisal fibers. The belly of the owl is also covered with sisal fibers. The whole of the head (approximately 50 percent of the surface are of the figure) is covered with fine strands of cattails. The wings and tail feathers are made of a combination of birch wood twig slices, straw, and banana leaf. The owl is perched on a wooden twig with a pine cone and plastic pine needles, and it has plastic eyes. Both the sisal and cattail pieces qualify as plaiting materials. Together, they cover approximately 75 percent of the owl figure’s surface.

The item is called the Leafinator. It is a garden rake used in household yards. The item at issue with this request is an aircraft cockpit Multifunction Control and Display Unit (MCDU) control panel subassembly, identified by part number 865-000163-2Z. The control panel subassembly is a component of the MCDU. A complete MCDU is installed in the cockpit of an aircraft and functions as the interface between the flight crew and the aircraft’s Flight Management System. The Flight Management System allows the the flight crew to input, select, modify, and display flight management information including the flight plan, navigation, and aircraft system data, et al. In it’s imported condition, the control panel subassembly cannot function as a complete MCDU because it does not contain an LCD display nor is it calibrated or tested for final use. The control panel subassembly is comprised of a number of components, including an electronic control assembly (ECA) which is a printed circuit board assembly populated with several push-button momentary contact switches, LEDs, resistors, photodiodes, a 40-pin electrical connector, and other minor electrical components. The ECA is further assembled onto a supportive backplate and front bezel with cutouts for the various push-button switches. After importation, an LCD display panel is added and the device is calibrated and tested.

This processing includes the conversion of a digital signal to analog to be used by various outputs, such as speakers, tweeter, subwoofers, etc. Additionally, the device can divide the frequencies, perform equalization, and adjust levels across various channels. We note that the device does not perform any amplification of sound.

The item under consideration is described as the Gabi System, which is a non-invasive, child-friendly, wearable device designed for continuous monitoring of pulse rate and blood volume variations. Utilizing advanced photoplethysmography (PPG) technology, the system employs red, infrared, and green LEDs to capture micro-fluctuations in blood circulation, translating optical absorption data into precise Pulse Rate (PR) and Oxygen Saturation (SpO2) metrics. This physiological data is securely transmitted in real-time via Bluetooth to mobile and cloud-based platforms, allowing parents and clinicians to monitor cardiovascular trends and review historical waveforms without disrupting the child’s daily routine or rest. The system is imported with the Gabi sensor, four various sized textile Gabi bands, a tablet with Gabi monitor app (to start and stop a recording of physiological parameters measured by the Gabi Sensor, displays measuring information, and transfers collected data to the Gabi Cloud via Wi-Fi), two charging cables, two power adapters, a quick setup guide and a set of instructions.

The items under consideration are described as LPD strainers (models LPD0300, LPD1000, and LPD2400), which are engineered to protect downstream fluid system components, such as pumps, valves, and heat exchangers, by removing particulate matter and debris from process media. These devices utilize an internal stainless-steel perforated screen, housed within a robust body constructed of cast iron or ductile iron depending on the specific model size. The strainers feature a specialized internal geometry and an oversized screen that significantly reduces pressure drop compared to conventional models. The units, which contain no moving parts, are suitable for horizontal or vertical installation in water, oil, gas, and other compatible fluid-service applications, and are equipped with integral flanges, a hinged bolted cover plate, and blowoff plugs to facilitate maintenance and operation. Each of the models perform the same function but are differentiated by their size, shape and composition.

The subject merchandise, “Quorn Meatless Diced ChiQin Pieces,” is a Quorn-branded line of meat-free products made from the principle ingredient, mycoprotein, a meat free protein. The product will be imported frozen, in Quorn-branded retail packaging weighing 28.2 ounces (800 grams). Quorn Meatless Diced ChiQin Pieces is said to contain mycoprotein paste, natural flavoring, yeast extract, onion powder, sage, sugar, salt, sunflower oil and free range egg white powder.

The products in question are the Silent-Aire Ballard Air Handling Units with Direct Evaporative Cooling (Ballard AHU DEC), items numbers 127-003229-009, 127-003924-001, and SA-500PN-ICVD. These industrial units rely on an integrated, direct evaporative cooling section built into the AHU and are designed for air-cooling applications in data centers and other large-scale facilities. These machines operate by drawing air through wetted evaporative media. As air passes through the media, water evaporates into the airstream, reducing air temperature. All units incorporate motor-driven fans, fixed evaporative cooling media, water distribution and drainage systems, and integrated controls to regulate airflow, waterflow, and operational parameters. The Ballard AHU DEC units do not employ refrigeration, compressed vapor cycles, or humidity-regulating devices characteristic of air conditioning machines. While humidity levels are affected, this is a secondary effect of the system and not the machines’ core function; any humidity functions occur as an indirect result of the cooling function. The units are not specifically designed to change the humidity in the environment. While the Ballard AHU DEC air handling units also filter and distribute the air, as noted their principal function is to cool the space through direct evaporative cooling.

The product at issue is a tire inflator, model SP00006. This device features an air hose assembly, a digital LCD display for pressure readings, and a valve housed in a pistol-grip body design (main body and trigger) constructed of plastic material. Once the power button is activated, the user can monitor tire pressure and based on the display reading, operate the valve to inflate or deflate the tire as needed. The tire inflator is packaged with batteries from China.

The merchandise under consideration consists of auxiliary motorcycle footpeg kits imported from Norway. Each kit consists of two footpegs with stainless steel mounting hardware, and is designed for installation on motorcycles. According to the information provided, a complete kit weighs approximately 1,700 grams, of which approximately 1,550 grams consists of aluminum alloy and the remaining approximately 150 grams consists of stainless steel. The auxiliary footpegs are model-specific and are installed in addition to the motorcycle’s original equipment footpegs, which remain in place. The subject footpegs mount directly to the motorcycle frame and provide the rider with an additional foot position during operation.

The item under consideration is described as a smart transmitter, which is a specialized, reusable medical device designed exclusively for use with the Eversense365 Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) system. As an integral component of this system, the transmitter is worn externally over an implanted glucose sensor to provide power and facilitate the wireless transmission of real-time glucose data, alerts, and trends to a compatible mobile application. Engineered for continuous wear, the device features an oval-shaped polycarbonate enclosure measuring approximately 48.0mm by 37.7mm by 9.2mm and weighing 14.0 grams. It is powered by an integrated, rechargeable lithium-polymer battery with an operational life of approximately 12 months, and it maintains connectivity with the mobile app at distances up to 24.9 feet under normal operating conditions. At the time of importation, these units are shipped separately from the implantable sensors in trays of 20, intended for subsequent integration into the final commercial packaging. Once combined with the sensor, the transmitter serves as a critical element of the Eversense365 system, which is indicated for the continuous measurement of glucose levels in adults with diabetes for up to one year.

PA6-imide is a polyamide based thermoplastic monofilament. It is an extruded monofilament having a solid, circular cross-section with a diameter of 1.75 millimeters. Documentation notes that the monofilament contains no reinforcements or filler. The monofilament will be imported on spools. The spools serve solely to hold and dispense the monofilament and contain no coding or identification circuitry. The principal use of the monofilament is feedstock for material extrusion additive manufacturing.
